findings.reason: The claim is correct: import() expressions inside an object literal run when the module is evaluated, so every app still loads eagerly and the PR adds await without the lazy-loading benefit, though the static imports it replaces also loaded everything at startup.

Verified in vital/lib/reschedule.ts: the try/catch wraps a forEach(async ...) whose body now awaits getCalendar, so a synchronous throw from new CalendarService(credential) becomes a discarded rejection that the catch no longer logs, while the same pattern already left deleteEvent fire-and-forget.
